verdict_reason: Copy and options match the prototype, but the page duplicates its heading in a visually hidden legend instead of making the legend the page heading.

todos.issue: A one-question radios page renders its own <h1> (line 9) and then a fieldset legend with the same text hidden by govuk-visually-hidden (lines 18-21), so screen readers announce 'Choose an address type' twice and the legend is not the heading GOV.UK Frontend makes it for a single-question page
todos.fix: Must: the radios fieldset legend is the page's only h1, carrying the caption, with no separate h1 or visually hidden duplicate. One way: drop the span and h1, and set legend { html: caption span + title, isPageHeading: true, classes: 'govuk-fieldset__legend--l' }; update the controller test that asserts a visually hidden legend
